human_readable_ui_steps.action: Launch Cursor Extension Development Host with temporary user profile and extension directory.
human_readable_ui_steps.details: Use Cursor.exe with --extensionDevelopmentPath pointing to the XIIGen extension repo, --extensionTestsPath pointing to a bounded host QA runner/test file, --user-data-dir set to a temp directory, --extensions-dir set to a temp directory, --disable-workspace-trust, --skip-welcome, --skip-release-notes, --skip-onboarding, --disable-telemetry, --disable-updates, --force-renderer-accessibility, --remote-debugging-address=127.0.0.1, --remote-debugging-port=<free local port>, --new-window, and workspace path set to the extension repo.

human_readable_ui_steps.action: Open the XIIGen Smart Skills panel.
human_readable_ui_steps.details: Invoke the real contributed command xiigenSmartSkills.panel, whose title is XIIGen: Open Smart Skills Panel. Do not use xiigenSmartSkills.__test.panelSubmitHandler or xiigenSmartSkills.runtimeProof.invoke for real UI proof.

human_readable_ui_steps.action: Type the chosen Row13.1a prompt into the XIIGen prompt textbox.
human_readable_ui_steps.details: Target textarea#xiigen-smart-skills-prompt / accessible label XIIGen task prompt. The field value must equal the chosen prompt exactly, and its SHA-256 must equal eca453b1fd9e7c925a21287bd52d3b8c907405efac387d7ebb2d8b6db2e60dd4.

human_readable_ui_steps.action: For Row13.3b panel-open/type-only, stop before submit and capture evidence.
human_readable_ui_steps.details: Capture screenshot, DOM/CDP selector proof, prompt field value, prompt hash, target id/source/session/context, and runner metadata. No panel submission, no core invocation, and no selected skill claim is allowed in Row13.3b if submit is not clicked.

human_readable_ui_steps.action: For a later submit/result row, click Submit to llm_mvp_core.
human_readable_ui_steps.details: Click button#xiigen-smart-skills-submit only in the authorized submit/result phase. Wait for xiigenSmartSkills.submitStatus followed by xiigenSmartSkills.submitResult or equivalent rendered result status.

human_readable_ui_steps.action: Capture screenshot, DOM, runtime, and core evidence.
human_readable_ui_steps.details: Capture the visible webview screenshot, CDP DOM snapshots proving the selectors and typed value, runner JSON/MD reports, runtime evidence directory refs, core request/response/trace refs, and rendered result text/hash.
